content: Streamlit st.login() (>=1.42) wires an OIDC client, redirects to the IdP, and on return stores an identity cookie then redirects into a NEW session -- st.session_state does not survive this redirect (session state resets on rerun/new session), so any pre-login state built in session_state before login is lost unless persisted via cookie or query param. Correct pattern is to read identity via st.user post-redirect, not to stash tokens in session_state. Community reports also show OIDC errors (bad redirect_uri, provider mismatch) surfacing only in a deployed/hosted context because localhost callback URLs differ from the production Space URL.
